description: MainActivity.kt defines a main activity for an Android app that manages navigation through a drawer and bottom navigation, handles fragment creation and switching, and manages UI state and back navigation.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The primary activity managing navigation and fragment display within the app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, navigation handlers, and restores prior state.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current navigation state to handle configuration changes.

methods.name: onSupportNavigateUp
methods.description: Overrides up navigation to open the drawer instead of default behavior.

methods.name: ensureFragmentsCreated
methods.description: Ensures all fragments are created and added to the fragment manager with proper tags.

methods.name: showDestination
methods.description: Displays the selected fragment corresponding to the navigation item.

methods.name: normalizeDestinationId
methods.description: Maps menu item IDs to consistent destination IDs.

methods.name: syncNavigationSelection
methods.description: Keeps the bottom navigation and drawer menu in sync with the current selection.
